label: Epona system
definition: A phage defense system in which an organism possesses an Epona locus represented by a VCA0366 profile that can protect bacteria from bacteriophage infection.
observations: Epona branch under phage defense system; distinct from individual VCA0366 genes, VCA0366 proteins, DefenseFinder HMM profiles, predicted source-database rows naming one Epona locus, unresolved Epona trigger or effector activities, and other phage defense systems.
